text: Duplicate Charge and Billing Refund Processing Document ID: SOP_C20_REFUND_PROCESSING Category: C20 — Refunds & Adjustments Department: Billing Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To standardise validation and issuance of refunds for duplicate or erroneous charges. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Validate the disputed transaction(s) against the payment gateway ledger. Approve refund if duplication or billing error is confirmed. Issue refund to source (5-7 working days) or as account credit (instant to 24 hours), per customer preference where offered. Record refund reason code for monthly billing-quality reporting. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable.
